description: Composite 'A-4C' assembled at the ESFA Córdoba from a TA-4J fuselage and parts of several airframes, unveiled 30 May 2014 as a cenotaph to Capt. José Vázquez carrying the false serial C-301; moved to the plazoleta beside the FAA headquarters, replacing the Gloster Meteor, and photographed there June 2026.
